operation_contract_reuse.are_external_mutation_operations: yes; plan_init and plan_retirement are the exact external mutation operations M4-5 handles via the Portable Plan Mutation Port; M4-5 does not create a parallel external operation meaning
operation_contract_reuse.consumes_canonical_intent: yes: consumes canonical MutationIntent + MutationPreconditions and trusted context/lease as typed runtime values

external_effect_mapping.VERIFIED: APPLIED_VERIFIED with AuthoritativeEffectConfirmation.YES (known success path via at-most-one attempt + verify)
external_effect_mapping.VERIFIED_RECOVERED: APPLIED_VERIFIED or REPLAYED_VERIFIED with evidence RECONCILING→candidate observed (authoritative read proves exact candidate)
external_effect_mapping.FAILED_NO_EFFECT: FAILED_NO_EFFECT with AuthoritativeEffectConfirmation.NO (definitive rejection or PREPARED without APPLYING)
external_effect_mapping.RETRYABLE_NO_EFFECT: FAILED_NO_EFFECT variant surfaced as no-effect but retryable only after fresh authorization (detail in evidence; status remains FAILED_NO_EFFECT class)
external_effect_mapping.CONFLICT: CONFLICT with AuthoritativeEffectConfirmation.NO (third observed state or authorization drift)
external_effect_mapping.OUTCOME_UNKNOWN: OUTCOME_UNKNOWN with AuthoritativeEffectConfirmation.UNKNOWN (stranded APPLYING / timeout before reconciliation)
external_effect_mapping.NEEDS_SEMANTIC_CHOICE: NEEDS_SEMANTIC_CHOICE with AuthoritativeEffectConfirmation.NO (multiple valid successors under retirement selection or ambiguous Project choice)

canonical_result_reuse.extension_required: no; current canonical result contract already supports required external effect states via MutationEffect + AuthoritativeEffectConfirmation and effect_evidence fields; add external verification evidence (observed_raw_digest, raw_source_revision, journal_state) to effect_evidence without inventing adapter-specific result semantics
